name: deck-export
description: Scaffolds a self-contained reveal.js deck project, and renders a finished deck to PDF or one PNG per slide

scripts.check:chromium: node --input-type=module -e "const { check } = await import('./scripts/lib/browser-runtime.js'); const c = await check(); if (!c.chromiumLaunch) { console.error(c.remediation || 'chromiumLaunch:false'); process.exit(1); } console.log(JSON.stringify(c));"
